name: tc-hotel-tourism-tax
description: Turks and Caicos hotel and tourism tax reference checked for 2026. Covers the administrative scope of the twelve percent levy, advance registration, the application-based small-provider exemption and monthly filing. Includes tax-exclusive and tax-inclusive examples and the 2026 switch to automated emailed remittance forms. Distinguishes accommodation and prescribed tourism services from a universal sales tax, and hotel-attached restaurants from other designated establishments. Use after the transaction’s taxable status and tax base have been established. The operative ordinance, subsequent amendments, records-retention conflict and special transaction rules require further reconciliation. This source-cited draft is not independently accountant-reviewed.
